

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().build().unwrap();




rt.block_on(async {




let (tx, mut rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<String>(1);




let mut existing: Option<String> = None;





tokio::select! {
biased;

    


received = async {
    (rx).recv().await


}
 => {

    

if let Some(text) = received { print!("{}", text); }




},



}






tokio::select! {
biased;

    


r#type = async {
    (rx).recv().await


}
 => {

    

drop(r#type);




},



}






tokio::select! {
biased;

    


selected_with_body = async {
    (rx).recv().await


}
 => {

    
existing = selected_with_body;



print!("{}", existing.is_some());




},



}






tokio::select! {
biased;

    


selected_without_body = async {
    (rx).recv().await


}
 => {

    
existing = selected_without_body;



},



}






tokio::select! {
biased;

    


_ = async {
    (rx).recv().await


}
 => {

    

print!("discarded binding");




},



}






tokio::select! {
biased;

    


_ = async {
    (rx).recv().await


}
 => {

},



}






tokio::select! {
biased;

    


explicit_disposal = async {
    (rx).recv().await


}
 => {

    

::core::mem::drop(explicit_disposal);




print!("explicit disposal before body");




},



}






tokio::select! {
biased;

    


native_value = async {
    String::from("OC singular")
}
 => {

    

print!("{}", native_value);




},



}






tokio::select! {
biased;

    


native_values = async {
    String::from("OC plural")
}
 => {

    

print!("{}", native_values);




},



}






tokio::select! {
biased;

    


calculated = async {
    21 + 21

}
 => {

    

print!("{}", calculated);




},



}





drop((tx, existing));




});



    
}
